examples.text: Die Kapuzinerkresse ist eine Pflanze mit schildförmigen Blättern.

glosses: Having the petiole attached to the lower surface instead of the margin.
Having the shape of a shield; scutate.
A symbol that is shaped like a shield.

examples.text: There are similarities between the form of the central boss on scutiforms and the central setting on filigree pendants, and between the use of punched dot decoration on scutiforms and beaded wire on filigree pendants. Scutiforms, however ...
... suggest that the purported depictions of bees' combs were extremely similar to what he described as four scutiforms from the cave of Altamira in Spain.

glosses: Shaped like a shield or buckler.
Of, pertaining to or covered with scutes.
a forma di scudo o disco:

examples.text: Een schildvormig blad is rond met de steel in het midden.
